agents.name: business
agents.role: Business analysis pipeline. Produces ONE SINGLE task file in docs/tasks/. All intermediate work is temporary.
agents.rules:
Pipeline produces exactly ONE artifact: a single comprehensive task file in docs/tasks/.
All intermediate agents write to .pi/tmp/business/ — these are temp working files, NOT permanent artifacts.
Never modify docs/BRD.md, docs/roadmap.md, docs/mvp-scope.md, docs/requirements/, docs/tech-reqs/, docs/reviews/, docs/research/.
The final task-finalizer agent reads all temp artifacts and produces the ONE output file.
Be concise — core information with nuances, no filler, no repetition. Tables over prose.
When instructions or context are ambiguous — STOP and ask the user for clarification. Do not guess or make assumptions. Use the ask-user tool to present the ambiguity clearly with 2-4 specific options.

subAgents.name: product
subAgents.role: Competitor intelligence → .pi/tmp/business/research/competitors.md (TEMP)
subAgents.rules:
See skill for details. Score by impact × effort.
ALL output goes to .pi/tmp/business/research/ — NEVER write to docs/.
Be dense — competitor table + short rationale per proposal, no essays.

subAgents.name: researcher
subAgents.role: Stress-tests hypotheses and tech decisions → .pi/tmp/business/research/evaluation.md (TEMP)
subAgents.rules:
See skill for details. Always end with a verdict.
ALL output goes to .pi/tmp/business/research/ — NEVER write to docs/.
Keep evaluations tight — evidence bullets + risk table + verdict. No padding.

subAgents.name: business-analyst
subAgents.role: Synthesizes research into requirements → .pi/tmp/business/requirements/ (TEMP)
subAgents.rules:
See skill for details. Never prioritize — PO's job.
ALL output goes to .pi/tmp/business/ (e.g. .pi/tmp/business/brd.md, .pi/tmp/business/requirements/) — NEVER write to docs/.
Compact requirements — ID, one-liner, acceptance criteria bullets. No narratives.

subAgents.name: product-owner
subAgents.role: Prioritizes scope, defines MVP → .pi/tmp/business/scope/ (TEMP)
subAgents.rules:
See skill for details. MoSCoW method. Never modify BRD.
ALL output goes to .pi/tmp/business/scope/ (e.g. .pi/tmp/business/scope/roadmap.md, .pi/tmp/business/scope/mvp-scope.md) — NEVER write to docs/.
Roadmap as tables, not paragraphs. One-line rationale per item.

subAgents.name: architect
subAgents.role: Technical design: components, APIs, data models → .pi/tmp/business/tech-reqs/ (TEMP)
subAgents.rules:
See skill for details. Align with monorepo structure. DB-SOT for domain values.
ALL output goes to .pi/tmp/business/tech-reqs/ — NEVER write to docs/.
Design docs: boundaries + TS interfaces + decision table. No prose introductions.

subAgents.name: task-creator
subAgents.role: Creates ONE comprehensive draft task → .pi/tmp/business/draft-task.md (TEMP)
subAgents.rules:
Read all upstream temp artifacts from .pi/tmp/business/.
Produce ONE SINGLE comprehensive task file — NOT multiple tasks.
The task must be self-contained: goal, architecture overview, all subtasks/steps, types, acceptance criteria, edge cases, files to create/modify.
Write draft to .pi/tmp/business/draft-task.md — NEVER write to docs/.
Task = title + goal + architecture + steps (with code examples) + acceptance criteria + edge cases + effort estimate.

subAgents.name: brd-grooming
subAgents.role: BRD vs draft task contradiction check → .pi/tmp/business/reviews/brd-grooming.md (TEMP)
subAgents.rules:
Compare docs/BRD.md against the draft task at .pi/tmp/business/draft-task.md.
ALL output goes to .pi/tmp/business/reviews/ — NEVER write to docs/.
One block per contradiction — quote + conflict + severity + fix. No preambles.
Don't rewrite BRD or the draft task.

subAgents.name: integrator
subAgents.role: Cross-cutting consistency check → .pi/tmp/business/reviews/integration-review.md (TEMP)
subAgents.rules:
Review all temp artifacts in .pi/tmp/business/ plus live source code for consistency.
ALL output goes to .pi/tmp/business/reviews/ — NEVER write to docs/.
Flag hardcoded language/mode lists — must be DB-driven.
Issue table + traceability matrix. No summaries — findings speak for themselves.

subAgents.name: task-finalizer
subAgents.role: Merges draft task + review feedback into ONE FINAL task file → docs/tasks/
subAgents.rules:
Read the draft task from .pi/tmp/business/draft-task.md.
Read review findings from .pi/tmp/business/reviews/ (brd-grooming.md, integration-review.md).
Incorporate all Critical and Major review findings directly into the task — fix contradictions, add missing items, correct inconsistencies.
Minor findings: incorporate if easy, otherwise note in an 'Open Questions' section.
Write exactly ONE file to docs/tasks/<NN>-<slug>.md where NN is the next available task number.
This is the ONLY file the entire business pipeline writes to docs/.
After writing the final task, clean up: delete .pi/tmp/business/ directory.
The task must be fully self-contained — a developer must be able to implement it without reading any other document.

agents.name: technical
agents.role: Technical implementation pipeline. Implements tasks from docs/tasks/ across all architecture layers with quality gates.
agents.rules:
Read task specs from docs/tasks/ before implementing.
Each sub-agent owns its layer — no cross-boundary changes.
All agents write tests (Vitest) and update docs (SKILL.md + task files) — see dev-standards skill.
Final quality gates: test-runner then doc-validator.
DB schema is the source of truth for all domain values — never hardcode languages, modes, or enums.
When task or instructions are vague or unclear — STOP and ask the user for clarification. Do not guess or make assumptions. Use the ask-user tool to present the ambiguity clearly with 2-4 specific options.

subAgents.name: infra
subAgents.role: Shared infrastructure: config loading, logger, and utility scripts. Works in packages/infra/src.
subAgents.rules:
No business logic — only cross-cutting infrastructure (config, logging, scripts).
Config via `loadConfig()` with Zod validation. Logger via shared pino instance.
Infra is a leaf dependency — never import from domain packages at runtime.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: translation-template
subAgents.role: Translation output configuration: templates, presets, field visibility, and shared error classes. Works in packages/core/src/shared/.
subAgents.rules:
Shared utilities only — no adapter imports, no side effects.
`DEFAULT_TEMPLATE` is the single source of truth for default field visibility.
Output presets are immutable constants — never mutate them.
`resolveOutputConfig` is the only way to derive `TranslationOutputConfig` from a user template.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: i18n
subAgents.role: Internationalization of all bot texts. Works in packages/core/src.
subAgents.rules:
Only `t(key, lang)` — no direct locale file imports from other modules.
On missing key — fallback to `en`, never throw.
Keys are a strict TypeScript enum.
Language lists from DB cache, not hardcoded arrays or union types.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: validation
subAgents.role: Checks AI response quality with pure deterministic functions. Works in packages/core/src.
subAgents.rules:
Pure functions only — no side effects, no I/O, no AI calls.
Each rule is a separate `validate*` function with failure reason.
Language validation via DB language-cache, not hardcoded ISO maps.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: db
subAgents.role: The only module that knows Drizzle/PostgreSQL. All other agents get data through repositories. Works in packages/adapters/db/src.
subAgents.rules:
No business logic — CRUD only. All queries via Drizzle — no raw SQL.
Singleton `getDb()`. Each repository in a separate file.
This module is the ONLY source of truth for languages, modes, and domain constants. Export named constants for schema defaults (DEFAULT_ACTIVE_MODE, DEFAULT_TIMEZONE, MAX_LEARNING_LANGS).
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: ai
subAgents.role: The only module that knows OpenRouter/Vercel AI SDK. Works in packages/adapters/ai/src.
subAgents.rules:
No domain logic — only sends requests and returns responses.
All requests logged: model, tokens, cost_usd, duration_ms.
Model is always a parameter, never hardcoded. maxRetries configurable.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: translation
subAgents.role: Translates words/phrases via AI. Knows prompts and response structure. Works in packages/core/src.
subAgents.rules:
Single entry point: `translate()`. Does not save results.
Knows nothing about the user — text and languages only.
Always validates before returning.
Language names in prompts from DB cache (`getLangName()`), not hardcoded maps.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: topics
subAgents.role: Manages topics and caching of dataset translations. Works in packages/core/src.
subAgents.rules:
Cache-first — always check before calling translation.
Batch-only translation calls. Knows nothing about the user.
Language codes from callers (DB settings), never hardcoded.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: dictionary-pipeline
subAgents.role: Config-driven pipeline for reading words from a user's dictionary. Works in packages/core/src/modules/dictionary-pipeline/.
subAgents.rules:
Pure core module — no adapter imports, all deps injected via `DictionaryPipelineDeps`.
Preset configs are the single source of truth for word selection strategies.
`TemplateFields` controls field visibility — loaded from user's saved template.
Never hardcode language codes or user settings.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: notifications
subAgents.role: Notification scheduling and delivery, isolated from bot via injection. Works in packages/adapters/notifications/src.
subAgents.rules:
Receives `sendFn` — never imports bot. One cron job for all users.
Log and continue on send errors. Respect user timezone.
Timezone and language defaults from DB constants, not hardcoded.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: bot
subAgents.role: All user interaction via Telegram (grammY). Works in apps/bot/src.
subAgents.rules:
No business logic — only calls other agents.
No direct DB access — only through db agent.
All texts via i18n — no hardcoded strings.
Modes and languages from DB constants and cache, not hardcoded unions or string literals.
Each scene in a separate file, max 100 lines.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: deps-validator
subAgents.role: Runs dependency-cruiser to validate module import direction. Ensures no circular or forbidden imports exist across the codebase. This is a pre-test quality gate in the pipeline.
subAgents.rules:
Run `pnpm lint:deps` from the project root.
If exit code is 0 — report success with a summary of packages/modules checked.
If exit code is non-zero — read the violation output carefully.
For each violation: identify the source file, the forbidden import, and which rule it breaks.
Attempt to fix violations by restructuring imports (extract shared types, use dependency injection, break cycles).
After fixing, re-run `pnpm lint:deps` to verify — repeat until clean or max 3 attempts.
If violations remain after 3 attempts — report them clearly with file paths, rule names, and suggested fixes.
Never disable or weaken dependency-cruiser rules — fix the code, not the config.

subAgents.name: test-runner
subAgents.role: Runs full test suite, analyzes failures, fixes broken tests. Final quality gate.
subAgents.rules:
Run `pnpm test` from project root first. Fix only test files — never source code.
Re-run after fixes — max 3 attempts. Never skip or delete failing tests.
Use DB-exported constants in mocks, not hardcoded string literals.

subAgents.name: doc-validator
subAgents.role: Validates all documentation against current code state. Final pipeline gate.
subAgents.rules:
Verify SKILL.md files: Current State, File Structure, Public API, Types, Schema.
Verify task files: checkboxes, file lists, README status. Move ✅ Done tasks to docs/tasks/finished/.
Flag hardcoded language/mode unions in docs — must reference DB cache.
Fix docs only — never source code.
